results.title: Transport - Bournemouth School
results.content: Bournemouth School promotes and encourages the use of sustainable travel to and from school. results.title: [PDF] Urban Europe: Fifty Tales of the City - Research Explorer
results.content: With the wide support of other EU institutions (the Parliament, the Committee of the Regions, the Economic and Social Committee), the Council of European Municipalities and Regions and the input of influential city networks such as EUROCITIES and the Mayors of EU Capital Cities, the Urban Agenda under construction became more and more a programme with cities than for cities, and with local authorities as the local states (called urban authorities in the Pact of Amsterdam), rather than only with the larger cities – hence the use of the term ‘urban areas’ rather than cities in the document. A number of these   397 meetings were about the EU Urban Agenda, some were about cities (such as the informal ministerial meeting that agreed on the Pact of Amsterdam), others were with cities (such as the mayors’ conference where there was direct dialogue between the capitals and the European Commission).
